title: NRP1 promotes hepatic fibrosis by regulating Src/Rab7-mediated lysosomal degradation of TβRI
task: Elucidate NRP1's role in regulating TGF-β receptor stability via Src/Rab7-mediated lysosomal degradation in hepatic stellate cells
key_results: NRP1 promotes HSC activation and hepatic fibrosis by suppressing TβRI lysosomal degradation through the Src/Rab7 axis, thereby sustaining TGF-β signaling
comments: This identifies a novel mechanism whereby NRP1 acts as a pro-fibrotic regulator by stabilizing TGF-β receptor signaling, suggesting NRP1 as a potential therapeutic target in hepatic fibrosis.

model_io.model: Hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) with NRP1 modulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: NRP1 functions as a co-receptor stabilizing TGF-β signaling by preventing Src/Rab7-mediated TβRI lysosomal degradation
hypotheses.result: Increased NRP1 expression correlates with elevated TβRI stability and enhanced HSC activation during fibrosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disrupting the NRP1/Src/Rab7 axis reduces TβRI stability and attenuates TGF-β-driven HSC activation
hypotheses.result: NRP1 or Src inhibition promotes TβRI lysosomal degradation and suppresses fibrotic progression

title: Determinants of pregnancy termination among ever-married women of reproductive age in Bangladesh
task: Predicting pregnancy termination risk factors using machine learning
key_results: Random Forest achieved 66.2% accuracy, 71.8% AUC; identified key predictors: number of children, employment status, age at first sex, recent birth history, respondent age
comments: Moderate predictive performance (AUC 71.8%) raises questions about clinical utility; imbalanced classes (pregnancy termination likely rare) may explain modest precision (40%) despite high specificity.

model_io.model: Random Forest, XGBoost, KNN, SVM, Artificial Neural Networks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning models can identify key sociodemographic and reproductive factors associated with pregnancy termination
hypotheses.result: Random Forest identified 5 significant factors; number of children, employment, and age at first sex most predictive

hypotheses.hypothesis: SHAP and LIME explainability techniques reveal interpretable feature associations
hypotheses.result: Applied but specific attribution results not detailed in abstract
